quest.rewards_formatted: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down" x1

dialogues.speaker: Langqing
dialogues.text: You like it that much? There's something I need to give you then, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Langqing
dialogues.text: I already gave out all the cultural souvenirs I brought before, and I feel bad for not holding one back for you... so it looks like this is my chance.

dialogues.speaker: Langqing
dialogues.text: That Fontainian musician — you know, the one that carries a guitar around — said it was alright for me to record the final version of his lyrics and sell them on as music merchandise.

dialogues.speaker: Langqing
dialogues.text: Here, please take it. It's nothing valuable, but if you like it you can keep it as a souvenir.
